messages:
elaine: PR #432 - SOC2 audit retention migration checklist draft. Moving SDK examples from v1 -> v2 and updating wording around retention periods. Ping @marcus and @legal for signoff.
marcus: thanks — can you paste the current wording here? worried about phrases like 'indefinite' or 'until request'.
elaine: current copy: ```We retain audit logs for 2 years by default. Customers may request earlier deletion; legal holds override deletion.```
legal: prefer: "Retention period: 24 months unless subject to legal hold or customer-initiated deletion requests." also please add a short clause that audit logs are encrypted at rest.
sam: for the SDK snippets, v2 changed the export call. need to show the redaction flag and new params. also the migration guide link in the PR is 404 right now.
elaine: ok will update. proposed snippet for docs: ```python
# v2 audit export example
client.export_audit_logs(format='jsonl', redact_pii=True, retention_months=24)
```
docs-bot: CI note: broken link detected in docs/migration/audit -> 404. please fix before merge.
elaine: fixed the link and updated wording per legal. pushed commit. @marcus can you confirm the fallback language about customer deletion vs legal hold?
marcus: LGTM on the wording overall. one small ask: add a clarifying sentence that audit logs contain request/response metadata and routing info, and do NOT include full customer prompt content unless customer enables sampling/retention of user content. :thumbsup:
legal: approved with tiny tweak — replace "customer-requested deletion" with "customer-initiated deletion requests" to be more explicit.
elaine: done and pushed. CI is green locally; will merge after the final CI run. thanks all.
sam: noted — i'll update the SDK changelog + migration notes once merged.
elaine: merged after CI passed. closing the thread. :tada:
